stories.title: PUBLIC MEETING NOTICE OF JEFFERSON COUNTY COMMISSION NOV.2 AND NOV. 11
stories.summary: This is a notice regarding the last meeting of the sitting Jefferson County Commission, and when the first meeting of the new Commission will be held following the Nov. 3 election.

stories.title: Birmingham woman, 61, killed in crash Sunday morning
Birmingham man killed in crash involving electric scooter
stories.summary: A Birmingham man was killed in a crash involving an electric scooter early Saturday morning, according to the Jefferson County Coroner's Office.
